tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) is the background, an action in progress: While he was walking, everyone was silent. Past simple is a finished action or event: When the herald walked in, the trumpets played. Often a short past simple action interrupts a longer past continuous one: I was writing when the Duke spoke. Use while + continuous, when + simple.
tasks.q_pl: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) is the background, an action in progress: While he was walking, everyone was silent. Past simple is a finished action or event: When the herald walked in, the trumpets played. Often a short past simple action interrupts a longer past continuous one: I was writing when the Duke spoke. Use while + continuous, when + simple.

Past simple is a finished action or event: When the herald walked in, the trumpets played. Often a short past simple action interrupts a longer past continuous one: I was writing when the Duke spoke. Use while + continuous, when + simple.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Туфір кладе протокол в архів і вперше киває: «Добре. Ти бачиш більше, ніж пишеш. Збирай мапи — за місяць ми летимо на Арракіс».
end_good.text_pl: Thufir odkłada protokół do archiwum i pierwszy raz kiwa głową: „Dobrze. Widzisz więcej, niż piszesz. Pakuj mapy — za miesiąc lecimy na Arrakis”.
end_good.text_en: Thufir puts the record in the archive and nods for the first time: “Good. You see more than you write. Pack your maps. In a month we fly to Arrakis.”
